captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a vintage service-station air pump. It features a main vertical red cylindrical barrel rising from a heavy, square black base. A T-shaped plunger handle with a grey metal rod and black grips slides vertically along the barrel axis. Mounted on the side of the barrel is a circular pressure gauge housing with a white dial face, below which a small black selector knob is rotatably attached.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a vintage service-station pump with a vertical red barrel on a heavy black base. The model must include a T-handle plunger that translates vertically (prismatic joint) and a small pressure selector knob below the gauge that rotates on its own axis (revolute joint).
captions.factory: The model is constructed by defining three main articulated parts. First, the base is created using a Box primitive, and the main red cylinder (barrel) is made from a Cylinder primitive with a chamfered top. Second, the plunger handle is built using a vertical Cylinder for the rod, a horizontal Cylinder for the handle bar, and two small capped cylinders for the hand grips. Third, the selector knob is modeled using a small cylindrical shaft and a tapered pointer. These components are structured using an articulated object framework with a prismatic joint for the plunger and a revolute joint for the selector knob.
